scope: Managed application support for ERP MES PLM and WMS
rationale: Buyer can consolidate specialist manufacturing application support into one outcome-based contract with committed service levels
key_risks: Loss of tacit plant knowledge; interface backlog during transition; vendor lock-in; service credits may not cover production downtime

scope: Hybrid infrastructure and database managed service for the on-prem estate
rationale: Move residual on-prem hosting and database administration to a committed private-cloud service
key_risks: Migration downtime; data residency constraints; unclear exit costs; legacy hardware dependencies

scope: Managed security operations for identity endpoint monitoring and privileged access
rationale: Consolidate 24x7 security monitoring and tool administration into a single managed service
key_risks: Loss of plant-specific threat context; alert fatigue; regulatory reporting gaps; handover of privileged access

scope: Service desk and end-user computing support for 2400 staff
rationale: Scale buyer service desk and device management across the division rather than duplicate local support
key_risks: Shift and language coverage; ticket backlog; user satisfaction decline; asset transfer disputes

scope: Finance and payroll transactional processing for AP AR payroll and expenses
rationale: Consolidate transactional finance and payroll processing into buyer shared services
key_risks: Payroll accuracy; works council consultation; control gaps during migration; dependency on legacy ERP
